criteria.DUPLICATE_VERSION: Duplicate/alternate version (same DOI or near-identical title) of another pool record.
criteria.PRE_2015_BACKGROUND: Published before 2015; outside the 2015-2026 window. Retained as background knowledge only (older seminal works enter the corpus only through the explicitly flagged baseline set).
criteria.PUBLICATION_TYPE: Dissertation, book, software/replication package, review, paratext or other grey-literature type not eligible as a peer-reviewed/preprint research source.
criteria.OUT_OF_SCOPE_ASSET: Underlying is not an equity index (FX, rates, commodities, energy, crypto, single-name equity, or a non-financial domain).
criteria.OFF_TOPIC: Title is not about implied-volatility/option-price surface construction or its arbitrage constraints.
criteria.FORECASTING_OR_TRADING: Surface forecasting, hedging or trading application rather than a construction/enforcement method.
criteria.MODEL_CALIBRATION_PRICING: Stochastic-volatility model calibration, asymptotics or option pricing without surface-construction enforcement.
criteria.RELEVANT_NOT_SELECTED: Topically relevant at title level but not selected: corpus cap (35-45), family balance, recency/version precedence, or already represented by a stronger record in the same family.
